  (b'{"services":["a"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"not","arg":{"op":"match","path":[]}}}],"queries":[[],["a"],["a","a"]]}', None),

    print('MATCH' if same else 'DIFF', raw[:70].decode())

# --- product count equivalence: optimized vs naive ---
rng = random.Random(4242)
ops = ['match','startswith','endswith','contains']
diff = 0

        atoms.add((op, p))
